stem.text: A cell of negligible internal resistance is connected in series with a thermistor, a fixed resistor and an ammeter.
The thermistor is placed in a beaker of water and the temperature of the water is slowly increased.
A graph of current $I$ against the temperature $T$ of the thermistor is plotted.
Which graph could show the variation of $I$ with $T$?

A.alt: Graph with vertical axis labelled I and horizontal axis labelled T, showing one curve.

B.alt: Graph with vertical axis labelled I and horizontal axis labelled T, showing one curve.

C.alt: Graph with vertical axis labelled I and horizontal axis labelled T, showing one straight line.

D.alt: Graph with vertical axis labelled I and horizontal axis labelled T, showing one curve.
